data.title: R2R - AI suggested
data.chainlabel: Intercompany transactions close first (recharges, netting, revaluation, trade AP and billing, AR / AP matching), then R2R monitors the towers' month-end tasks, the statements are reviewed and signed off (Controlling / Embedded Finance, to confirm) and R2R closes SAP by WD+2 5pm; Legal entity data is loaded into ERH, supplemented, validated and reconciled to SAP and the units are promoted to GFR by WD+4; in parallel the intercompany balances are matched, reconciled and the module locked by WD+3. Both roll up into Group Consolidation & Reporting (GFR); GL and sub-ledger accounts are reconciled in BlackLine by risk rating, differences resolved, certified and approved; required adjustments are followed up as action plans in the following months; Controlling (Middle Office), FP&A Ops and FP&A Comm review each reporting unit's reconciliations and certify the management review group - not an R2R activity; The non-SOX Power BI pack (GPS dashboard) and the SOX non-hub spreadsheet pack (R2R for CN10 and CN20) are reviewed and signed off by the CFO, with escalation to the Group Financial Controller
data.asisnote: Blue = AI suggested (Claude recommendation, hypothesis to validate with the R2R team and the LT); green = TPI register item (Coupa Accrual Reports and Payroll Interface registers, Jul-Aug 2026); everything else as documented on the As-Is map; flow validation update from R2R & P2P flows validation.docx: Pending confirmation with Lai Leng: confirm whether her team performs the P&L and balance sheet review, CFO sign-off coordination and close checklist sign-off. Ownership remains provisional. Pending alignment with Controlling: align the BSR management review flow and both BSI Pack flows (Non-SOX and SOX Non-Hubs) with the Controlling team.

fixes.Certain SAP module closes (MMPV, MMRV, M: Schedule the market-specific module closes (MMPV, MMRV, MM module, OKP1) as steps of the close job with an AI triage of failures, so OB52 and manual closes are the exception rather than the routine.
fixes.Completeness of new lines in ERH 101 and: Automated completeness check of the new ERH 101 / 102 lines against SAP each quarter, with the exceptions and variances over USD100k listed for the reviewer instead of a manual check.
fixes.Manual MOT preparation: A bot drafts the quarterly MOT and the supplementary schedules from the ERH and SAP extracts for R2R to review and complete in Smart View.
fixes.Manual SAP data extraction for the BSR w: Python extraction of the SAP data into the BSR working file (piloted, being globalised on a virtual machine), with an AI completeness and variance check on the supporting documents and a flag on oversized attachments.
fixes.Excessive supporting documents increase: AI completeness check flags oversized or duplicate attachments and the supporting documents are linked rather than embedded, so the working file stays small (with the BSR automation).
fixes.Journals in BlackLine show a posting err: Automated reconciliation of the BlackLine journal posting status against SAP, auto-correcting journals confirmed as posted instead of the manual Journal Status file import (pending the permanent AZ IT fix).
fixes.Manual process - SOX entities are not in: Extend the auto-generated Power BI BSI pack to the SOX non-hub entities CN10 and CN20, removing the manual spreadsheet build for that scope.
